text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I return from an outing with Mejiro Ryan…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: There you are, Ryan! Hurry, hurry, get over here!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wh-what's going on?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin suddenly appears and drags Mejiro Ryan away. I rush after them to see what's up.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, everyone! I found Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Nice work, Ines! Quick, Ryan, get on the court!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What's this? A volleyball match?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's right! We're having an interclass match. It's been a real back-and-forth game!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And you're here just in time to be our surprise pinch server!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: W-well, I don't really know how well I'll do…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: But if you need me, then I gotta try! Gimme a moment!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm ready. Let's resume the match!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Gooo, Ryan! Ace that serve!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I'll do what I can! Don't hold back the cheers!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Here we go! Concentrate…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You can always count on Ryan to get into it, hehe. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The whistle sounds, and Mejiro Ryan launches her serve…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thwack!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Not only did you ace the serve, you showed off some great offense and defense after!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd nail it! You're a real-life goddess of victory! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: For real! What a great idea it was to bring you into the game!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha, glad to hear it!
choice_data_list: I'm proud to be your trainer!
I'm proud to be your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha, glad to hear it!
choice_data_list: I'm proud to be your trainer!
I'm proud to be your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Of course she is! Ryan's our inspiration—loved by all!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Ryan's our hero!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wow, that's a little embarrassing to hear, but… thanks! Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best not to let anyone down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even as an unexpected substitute, Mejiro Ryan's active presence makes it obvious why she's so popular.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much! Hehe, I think I'm blushing…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Wooo! Your trainer's pretty bold to say that in front of everyone!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whistle! Right, guys?

text_block_list.name: Classmates
text_block_list.text: Whistle! Yeah! We all heard it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: What?! N-no, it's not like that! Give us a break here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by her classmates, Mejiro Ryan is a bit embarrassed, but it's clear she's popular as someone they can depend on.
